#Q1: Descriptive Analysis
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(34216375) # Your Student Number
VCData = read.csv("WVSExtract.csv")
VC = VCData[sample(1:nrow(VCData),100000, replace=FALSE),]
VC = VC[,c(1:3,sort(sample(4:50,25,replace=FALSE)),
sort(sample(51:65,8,replace=FALSE)))]
dim(VC)
```


```{r}
summary(VC)
```
```{r}
VCQ1 <- VC %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .)))
colSums(is.na(VCQ1))
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
```





```{r}
VC1 <- VC %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .))) %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

View(VC1)
```



```{r}
png("boxplot_PRI.png", width = 1200, height = 800, res = 150)

par(mar = c(7, 2, 0, 1))
boxplot(VC1[,4:36], las = 2)
PRI <- VC1[41,4:36]
points(1:length(PRI), PRI, col = "red", pch = 19)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
VCGroup <- VC %>%
  mutate(Focus = ifelse(Country == "PRI", 1, 2))

VCQ3 <- VCGroup %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus), ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .))) %>%
  group_by(Year, Focus) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)))) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  select(-Wave)

VCQ3Long <- VCQ3 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Year, Focus),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Value = ifelse(is.nan(Value), NA, Value))

```


```{r}

h <- ggplot(VCQ3Long, aes(x = Year, y = Variable, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "Black",  size=0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", na.value = "grey90") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  facet_wrap(~Focus)

ggsave("heat_map.png", plot = h,
       width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

VCQ3b1 <- VCGroup %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus, Country), ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus, Country), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)))) %>%
  filter(Country == "PRI") %>%
  select(-Wave, -CEU)
  
  
VCQ3b2 <- VCGroup %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus, Country), ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Year, Focus, Country), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)))) %>%
  filter(Country != "PRI") %>%
  select(-Wave, -CEU)
  
print(unique(VCQ3b$Year))
  
```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
install.packages("backports")
library(broom)
```


```{r}
bump_data_focus <- data.frame()
predictors <- c("PolScale","PolLeader","PrivateState","PolInterest",
                "PolBoycott","PolDemons","PolExperts","ILFriends",
                "ILReligion","ICQHardWork","ICQImagination","ICQTolerance",
                "ICQThrift","Happy","Health","Trusted","LifeSatis",
                "FutureWork","ACTReligion","ACTSport","ACTArtsEd",
                "ACTUnions","ACTProfessional","ACTHumanitarian","HardWork")
predictors2001 <- c("PolScale","PolLeader","PrivateState","PolInterest",
                "PolBoycott","PolDemons","PolExperts","ILFriends",
                "ILReligion","ICQHardWork","ICQImagination","ICQTolerance",
                "ICQThrift","Happy","Health","Trusted","LifeSatis",
                "FutureWork")

confidence <- c("CPress", "CParliament", "CCivilService", "CTelevision", "CGovernment", "CMajComp", "CWomensMvt")

for (c in confidence) {
  formula <- as.formula(
      paste(c, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
    )
  
  lm1995 <- lm(formula, data=VCQ3b1[VCQ3b1$Year == 1995,])
  
  temp1995 <- tidy(lm1995) %>% 
    filter(term!= "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(confidence = c,
           year = 1995,
           estimate = abs(estimate),
           focus = 1)
  
  bump_data_focus <- bind_rows(bump_data_focus, temp1995)
}

for (c in confidence) {
  formula <- as.formula(
      paste(c, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
    )
  
  lm1995 <- lm(formula, data=VCQ3b2[VCQ3b2$Year == 1995,])
  
  temp1995 <- tidy(lm1995) %>% 
    filter(term!= "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(confidence = c,
           year = 1995,
           estimate = abs(estimate),
           focus = 2)
  
  bump_data_focus <- bind_rows(bump_data_focus, temp1995)
}



for (c in confidence){

}

```

```{r}

bump_data_focus <- bump_data_focus %>%
  group_by(focus, confidence, year) %>%
  arrange(p.value, desc(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())%>%
  ungroup()

label_start <- bump_data_focus %>%
  group_by(focus, confidence, term) %>%
  filter(year == 1995)

label_end <- bump_data_focus %>%
  group_by(focus, confidence, term) %>%
  filter(year == 2018)
```

```{r}
label_start_mid <-bump_data_focus %>%
  group_by(confidence, term) %>%
  filter(year != 2018)


```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(bump_data_focus,
       aes(x = year,
           y = rank,
           group = term,
           color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_grid(focus ~ confidence,
           labeller = labeller(focus = c("1" = "Puerto Rico",
                                         "2" = "Other Countries")))+
  labs(
    title = "Top Predictors of Confidence Across Years",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rank (1 = most important)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = label_start,
            aes(label = term),
            hjust = -0.2,
            size = 3,
            vjust=1.5,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = label_end,
            aes(label = term),
            hjust =1.2,
            vjust=1.5,
            size = 3,
            show.legend = FALSE)


```

ggsave("bump_chart_focus.png", plot = p,
